categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet import and keypool refill logic in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp and src/wallet/imports.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes node aborts and UBSan signed integer overflows when importing descriptors with edge-case ranges or large keypool values. The PR description notes that importing range '[2147483647, 2147483647] produces an end of 2^31, which narrows to a negative value and aborts the node during keypool top-up', which multiple reviewers confirmed crashing on master.
